"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When President Obama took office, the U.S. was losing hundreds of thousands of jobs per month.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Expanding the Earned Income Tax Credit and the Child Tax Credit, and supporting unemployment insurance benefits and food stamps, reduced poverty for 32 million more people in 2010.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration invested in Promise Neighborhoods across the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration provided grants to financial institutions in urban and rural communities to increase lending for low-income Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
